label: FIRST-MOMENT DIAGNOSTIC ON N2R - PREPARED, QUALIFIED ON SYNTHETIC FIXTURES, NOT APPROVED, NOT EXECUTED ON N2R

status.compiled_where: natively from the pinned tag with the patch applied; see compiled_qualification.json. The reviewed IMAGE could not be built in the preparation session - see image_blocker.

image_blocker.exact_error: gateway answered 403 to CONNECT for production.cloudfront.docker.com:443 (Docker Hub blob CDN) while pulling the digest-pinned ubuntu:24.04 base
image_blocker.not_routed_around: no alternative registry or mirror was used: an organization egress denial is reported, not worked around
image_blocker.consequence: the image ID, repo digest and PALACE_PATCH_SHA256 that a qualifying run must carry can only be produced by a build in an environment where that host is allowed

what_would_be_computed.space: N2R's Nedelec space: same mesh file, same two-level box refinement, order 1, MGMaxLevels 1, same PEC attributes {2, 4}, same lumped port (attribute 10, +Y, L = 1.0345665367517793e-07 H, R = C = 0)
what_would_be_computed.functional: f = P^T v, v = LumpedPortData::v (the exact GetVoltage form), zeroed on the PEC true dofs
what_would_be_computed.solve: M x = f by PCG + Jacobi, RelTol 1e-12, MaxIts 2000; independent residual r = M x - f
what_would_be_computed.A_nd: Re(f^T x) / L_nd  with  L_nd = L_H / (mu0 Lc)

error_qualification.identity: A_computed - A_exact = (Re(x^H r) - r^H M^-1 r) / L
error_qualification.certified: one-sided only: A_exact >= A_computed - Re(x^H r)/L, because r^H M^-1 r >= 0 for SPD M
error_qualification.not_certified: no upper bound on A_exact; ||x|| ||r|| / L is reported as an ESTIMATE and is not a bound

checks_built_in: f . Re(E) + i f . Im(E) == GetVoltage(E) on a random complex field zeroed on the PEC dofs (structured FAILED record, then abort)
u^T K u >= (f . u)^2 / L_nd for x and four random constrained fields - a SAMPLED runtime check, not a proof
x vanishes on the PEC dofs; ||r|| / ||f|| reported

enforces.wall_clock: the container is read line by line under a deadline and KILLED on expiry; the bare docker command in the earlier proposal was not a timeout mechanism
enforces.dof: the streamed log is probed for the finest-space ND count and the container is KILLED the moment it exceeds the budget
enforces.provenance: image ID, repo digests, labels, the four PALACE_* files read from inside the image, and the sha256 of config, mesh, patch, Dockerfile and diagnostic code are written to provenance.json

image.must_be_built_where: an environment whose egress policy allows the Docker Hub blob CDN; see image_blocker

required_provenance.image_id: SUPPLIED BY THE EXECUTION: the image ID the launcher records

hard_caps.meaning: hard caps on the execution, not runtime promises. The space is N2R's, 103411 true dofs, so the DOF cap is known to hold; the wall cap is enforced by the launcher, and a run that hits either cap is FAILED, never retried

the_one_execution.mechanism: NO workflow runs this and none is added by this preparation. The approval must name the mechanism - a separate manually dispatched workflow that builds docker/palace-first-moment.Dockerfile, or a local run whose record is committed - and must not reuse the spent PO1 approval or edit .github/ladder-approval.json.
the_one_execution.what_it_authorises: one execution of this config with this image, once; no retry
what_it_does_not_authorise: no eigensolve, no driven sweep, no N3, no golden run
no Route A or Route B extraction, no real-data E_C or g
no registered-definition change, no historical-record rewrite
no budget or cap increase, no merge of PR #7

expected_scales.note: expected values only: the diagnostic record reports Lc, tc and the scales it actually used, and the evaluator compares against those

A_all_saved_modes.source: printed precision of the committed columns only

eigensolver_convergence.why: eig.csv reports a backward and an absolute error per eigenpair; turning either into an error on p_m = (q^H E_m)^2 / lambda_m needs a spectral gap, which the committed record does not measure. It is therefore kept out of the interval and stated separately, and any tail conclusion must account for it.

what_the_comparison_will_and_will_not_sa: A_direct - A_saved is called an omitted first moment only after every provenance and numerical check in evaluate_record.py passes
only a CERTIFIED LOWER BOUND on the omitted moment can be stated, from A_certified_lower - A_saved_hi; there is no certified upper bound, so a small difference is NOT RESOLVED and never a small tail
a materially negative difference is flagged INCONSISTENT - the non-negative mode weights forbid it - and is never labelled an omitted moment
mass-solve uncertainty and A_saved uncertainty are reported separately
E_C and g stay UNAVAILABLE whatever the number
